recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic portrait of a pilot in flight gear standing before a fighter jet with an open cockpit, set against a dramatic golden-hour sky with high-contrast warm lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Pilot as the primary focal point in the right foreground
Fighter jet cockpit canopy framing the pilot's head from the left
Golden sunset light creating rim lighting on the pilot and metallic surfaces
Graphic title treatment anchored in the lower-center third
coreInvariants: Shallow depth of field blurring the jet's tail
High-contrast shadows on the flight suit

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Pilot occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from waist up; jet cockpit dominates the left background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pilot's face and the high-contrast white title logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the pilot's face, follows the diagonal line of the cockpit canopy down to the central title, then scans the metadata at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Atmospheric sky in the upper right and left provides breathing room for secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Golden amber and warm yellow (sky and highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and olive drab (flight suit and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the highlights; low value/high contrast in the subject's clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal shearing or stretching to fit geometric containers
Integrated graphic wings flanking the central text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are clipped or integrated into a horizontal bar structure
Star motif integrated into the bottom of the central lockup
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric display face paired with a light, airy condensed secondary face.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence for the main title.
Matches the technical, military feel of the metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic photo of a male pilot in a dark olive flight suit standing in front of a modern fighter jet. The jet's cockpit is open. The background is a hazy, golden sunset sky. High contrast, rim lighting on the pilot's silhouette. No text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, white geometric sans-serif title in the lower center. Flank the title with horizontal wing-like stripes. Add small, wide-tracked condensed uppercase text at the very top and very bottom edges.

verificationChecks: Is the main title perfectly centered?
Does the pilot have a sharp rim light?
Is the jet cockpit used as a framing element?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the golden hour glow
Specific model of the fighter jet
Tightness of the tracking on metadata
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is not garbled or AI-hallucinated
Check that the pilot's gear looks authentic to aviation
Verify the golden hour color balance is not overly orange
Confirm the title graphic does not obscure the pilot's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Heroic Figure) + Backdrop (Technical Machinery) + Lighting (Golden Hour Rim Light) + Typography (Heavy Geometric Center Lockup).
